summary: Iteration 150: Tested AI Meeting Coach, Eye Contact Correction, and Enhanced Whiteboard features. Backend: 18/18 tests passed (100%). All AI Coach endpoints work correctly - tip returns coaching advice with category/urgency/emoji, report returns tips_count/areas/improvement_focus, nonexistent meetings return empty report. All regression tests pass (AI research, voice commands, sentiment analysis, translation). Frontend: Fixed critical JavaScript bug ('Cannot access canStream before initialization') that prevented WebinarLiveRoom from loading. After fix, all required data-testid attributes verified present and functional.

fixed_bugs.fix: Changed useEffect dependency from 'canStream' to 'roomInfo?.can_stream_video' since canStream is defined after the useEffect hook

Coaching categories: engagement, pacing, clarity, energy, interaction, time_management
Urgency levels: low, medium, high - determined by engagement score and speaking duration

AI Coach tips auto-request every 60s for host/presenter with streaming permission
